title: Crypto Wallet & Seed Phrase Harvesting Pattern
description: URL structure or query parameters attempt to solicit cryptocurrency recovery seed phrases, mnemonic phrases, private keys, or wallet restoration credentials.

title: Brand Impersonation & Typosquatting
description: Domain or hostname contains a high-value trademarked brand name (e.g., Apple iCloud, PayPal, Google, Microsoft, SBI, Netflix) registered on an unauthorized third-party registrar.

title: Raw Numerical IP Address Host
description: Host uses a raw numerical IP address instead of a registered domain name, common in malicious phishing and command-and-control infrastructure.

title: Direct Executable / Malware Payload Link
description: URL path points directly to an executable, script, or archive file (.exe, .scr, .vbs, .apk, .iso, .ps1, .hta, .zip).

title: Deceptive Double File Extension
description: URL disguises an executable payload behind a fake document extension (e.g., invoice.pdf.exe).

title: URI Userinfo @ Obfuscation Trick
description: URL contains an '@' character to confuse browser address bars and redirect users to a malicious host.

title: Internationalized / Punycode Homograph
description: URL contains punycode (xn--) or non-ASCII characters often used in visual homograph brand spoofing.

title: Abused Free Cloud / Tunnel Hosting
description: URL is hosted on a free subdomain/tunnel service commonly abused for disposable phishing campaigns (ngrok, trycloudflare, pages.dev, firebaseapp).

title: Pre-filled Victim Email Parameter in Query
description: URL contains an embedded email address parameter, characteristic of targeted credential phishing lures.

title: Open Redirect Parameter Detected
description: URL query contains redirection parameters (url=, redirect=, target=, next=) often abused to bypass email security filters.

title: Credential Harvesting Keywords in Path
description: URL path or query contains sensitive credential keywords like login, verify, secure, account, update, banking, kyc, otp, restore, seed.

title: High-Risk / Disposable Top-Level Domain (TLD)
description: Domain uses a TLD frequently associated with spam, malware, and disposable phishing campaigns (.xyz, .top, .tk, .icu, .buzz, .fit, .monster, .click, .quest).

title: Obfuscated Link Shortener Service
description: URL uses a link shortening service (bit.ly, tinyurl, t.co, is.gd) hiding the final destination address.

title: Excessive Hyphens in Domain Name
description: Domain or hostname contains multiple hyphens used to mimic legitimate multi-word services (e.g., secure-update-login-bank.com).

title: Excessive Subdomain Stacking
description: URL contains 3 or more nested subdomains used to disguise the real destination root domain.

title: Suspicious Numerical Digits in Hostname
description: Hostname contains 4 or more numeric digits, characteristic of automated domain generation algorithms (DGA).

title: Non-Standard Web Service Port
description: URL specifies a non-standard port (:8080, :8443, :8000, :8888) outside standard web ports 80 and 443.

title: Deceptive Double Slash in Path
description: URL path contains double slashes '//' used to trick legacy URL parsers and security gateways.

title: Internal / Loopback SSRF Address
description: Host resolves to an internal RFC 1918 private network or loopback address.

title: Abnormally Long URL
description: URL length exceeds 120 characters, often indicating base64 encoded payloads or token padding.
